text:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — saw ~120 requests bounce to the degen route in eu-west over the last 5m. Console labels show "validation:reject" but the customer endpoint still returns 200 because router silently fell back. Example tool payload that triggered it:

Maria Lopez: ```json
{
  "tool": "charge-svc",
  "result": {
    "status": "urgent",
    "amount": 12.34
  }
}
```

Jon Park: Can you paste the validator error/trace you saw?

Maria Lopez: ```
ValidationError: enum value "urgent" not in allowed set ["high", "medium", "low"] at /result/status
router.route_id=toolhook-degen-flip
```

Kevin Chen: Two separate problems here: (1) router policy should not silently hide a validation downgrade (degen) without a clear reason in the request/response path; (2) console UX shows "validation:reject" but doesn't connect the sample to the customer request or the fallback route. Both lead to support tickets.

Sara Iqbal: Agree. Quick mitigation: validator could emit a "suggested_coercion" hint (e.g. map "urgent"->"high") so router can optionally coerce for permissive canaries. That would reduce noise for low-risk enums.

Ashok Reddy: Coercion is a policy decision — we need telemetry first. Proposal: emit three counters per-customer: rejected_enum, coerced_enum, coerced_by_policy. Also add tag `validation_level` (strict|permissive|coerce).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling canary rollout for "validator-soft-enum" feature at 1767805200 (staged). :clock1:

Maria Lopez: I don't want the canary to run org-wide yet. We need: (A) router logs surface `fallback_reason` in structured log + `suggested_fix` from validator, (B) console shows a validation sample for each failed-to-serve request (admin-only), (C) billing telemetry to avoid misattributing degen traffic.

Kevin Chen: For (C) we should add a stable routing_tag that indicates original intended route vs actual served route so billing can split. Also mark any coerced responses with `x-redwood-coerced: true` header for debug customers.

console-product: We can add a "Validation samples" pane in the route dashboard that shows the last 10 rejected payloads (masked) plus the validator's suggested_fix. We'll gate by admin role and add a "apply suggestion" CTA which only records a requested mapping (no automatic change). Mockup ETA: EOW.

Jon Park: I'll add a router flag `emit_validator_hints=true` and include `suggested_fix` and `fallback_reason` in the JSON log blob. Will also tag telemetry with `route_intended` so billing team can join. Patch in PR today.

Maria Lopez: Nice. Action items summary: Jon -> router log flag + telemetry tag (P0). Console -> validation sample pane (P1). Ops -> hold the soft-enum canary until we have the metrics (P2). Billing -> accept `route_intended` tag mapping. I'll file followups and attach sample traces.

Kevin Chen: cc @Ashok Reddy for policy knobs; @console-product please ping when mock exists so we can test with real rejected samples.

Sara Iqbal: And let's add an internal header for devs `X-Redwood-Fallback: validator_reject->degen` so support can quickly see fallback cause without exposing to normal customers.

Maria Lopez: Thanks all. I'll open the ticket linking these notes and the trace. :thumbsup:

Jon Park: ack. Will post PR link here once ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note — canary remains paused until manual resume by ops.

Ashok Reddy: 👍
